technical_identity_rationale: app_id uses the repository owner's GitHub namespace so no unowned domain is implied; data_directory follows the Tauri app-data convention for that identifier; uri_scheme is reserved but registered only when a feature needs it; signature/hash domains are versioned ASCII separation labels used inside signed/hashed payloads (DEC-PACK-CRYPTO, peer protocol). update_manifest_origin stays null until the updater service is specified (UPDATE-001, M8).
